exposure: Pain score upon local anesthetic injection for spinal anesthesia
increased pre-operative central sensitization inventory (CSI) scores
Sub-acute post-cesarean pain (lasting 4 weeks or more)
outcome: Sub-acute post-cesarean pain (lasting 4 weeks or more)
cohort: Women undergoing cesarean delivery under spinal anesthesia
finding: Pain score upon local anesthetic injection was not associated with acute post-cesarean pain but was significantly associated with sub-acute post-cesarean pain.
